verdict.rationale: Cursor documents API-key authentication as a first-class alternative to account login: CLI supports 'export CURSOR_API_KEY=...' for scripts/CI, service accounts issue non-human API keys to 'authenticate the CLI...without tying integrations to individual developers' personal accounts,' and the Cloud Agents/Admin/Analytics APIs all authenticate via Basic/Bearer API keys rather than interactive login. A live probe confirms the API host is key-gated (401 Invalid User API Key) rather than session-based. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation outside Cursor's own docs that API-key auth fully substitutes for login in the IDE itself (docs focus on CLI/CI/service-account contexts, not primary IDE sign-in).
